name: Koro Sun Resort and Rainforest Spa
insider_take: Hidden on Vanua Levu's pristine coastline, this eco-luxury retreat sits where ancient rainforest meets crystal-clear lagoon—pure Fijian magic.
whats_special: Set on 160 acres of untouched rainforest, Koro Sun Resort is one of Fiji's most secluded luxury escapes. The property features authentic Fijian bures (traditional thatched cottages) overlooking Savusavu Bay, plus Fiji's first rainforest spa built around a natural spring. You'll find rare bird species, hidden waterfalls, and some of the world's best soft coral diving right offshore.
pro_tip: Book the Rainforest Spa's signature "Bobo Massage" performed in a treetop pavilion—it's conducted to the sounds of native birds and flowing spring water for an unforgettable sensory experience.
dont_miss: The resort's private hiking trails lead to spectacular viewpoints and a sacred Fijian waterfall. Take the complimentary guided rainforest walk to spot the endangered Fiji crested iguana, or join a traditional kava ceremony with local villagers. The nearby Savusavu town is famous as Fiji's "hidden paradise" with natural hot springs and pearl farms.
pros: Stunning rainforest setting with lush tropical gardens
Full-service spa offering traditional Fijian treatments
Direct access to pristine coral reefs for snorkeling
Authentic Fijian cultural experiences and activities
cons: Remote location requires longer transfer times
Limited dining options due to secluded setting
